scientific_queries.note: First use of the target-gene columns to test whether annotation granularity drives the finding.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round closes a limitation that had been carried in the register since C46, using a column the programme had never touched.

what_this_resolves.the_C46_limitation: the annotation signal is not an artefact of using a coarse annotation, since the finer target block gives the same order of signal rather than a decisive improvement
what_this_resolves.combining_never_hurts: plus_both is at or above plus_pathway in all three pools

robustness_concern_flagged.cause: different random streams, because the capacity block consumes the RNG differently, giving different splits
robustness_concern_flagged.implication: the magnitude of this contrast is not stable between runs and should only be quoted from the highest-powered run

limits: target strings mix genes and complexes, so the target block is not a clean gene set
the three pools share one training set
the capacity control uses a single block, weaker than R101's ten-block average
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: robustness is now the main weakness: run the same contrast under five independent random streams and report the between-stream spread
